great.name: Room rent (no capping)

great.reference: Annexure III - Product Benefit Table (VIP) | Hospitalization Treatment
great.explanation: No room category restriction/cap is mentioned for VIP; eligible room rent is payable at actuals up to Sum Insured.

great.name: Restore/Reload benefit (unlimited refills)
great.quote: Super Reload (Unlimited Refill) From 2nd claim of Policy Life - Unlimited times
great.reference: Annexure III - Product Benefit Table (VIP) | In-built Benefits
great.explanation: After the first-ever claim in the policy’s lifetime, the plan can reload up to Base Sum Insured unlimited times in a policy year (subject to terms).

great.name: Consumables / Non-medical expenses covered (Claim Protect)
great.quote: Non-payable items will be covered (all 4 lists of Annexure I)
great.reference: Annexure III - Product Benefit Table (VIP) | Hospitalization Treatment
great.explanation: Covers otherwise non-payable consumables/non-medical items listed in Annexure I (Lists I-IV), reducing out-of-pocket expenses.

great.name: Pre-hospitalization (90 days)
great.quote: The Company shall indemnify the Pre-Hospitalization Medical Expenses incurred... for up to 90 days immediately prior to the date of such Hospitalization.
great.explanation: Covers diagnostic/medical expenses up to 90 days before admission (linked to an admissible hospitalization).

great.name: Built-in additional SI buffer after base exhaustion (Super Reload)
great.quote: If the Base Sum Insured is completely exhausted or is insufficient for covering a claim, then We shall provide for a reload amounting to the Base Sum Insured (“super Reload”), unlimited times during the Policy Year
great.explanation: Provides extra coverage that activates after Base SI is exhausted/insufficient (a strong protection feature).

good.name: PED waiting period (3 years)
good.quote: Pre Existing Disease (PED) Waiting Period 3 years
good.reference: Annexure III - Product Benefit Table (VIP) | Waiting Period - Inbuilt Cover
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are covered after 3 years of continuous coverage (industry-standard; not a red flag).

good.name: Initial waiting period (30 days)
good.quote: 30-day Waiting Period (Code-Excl03) ... Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident
good.explanation: Standard 30-day initial waiting for illness (accidents are covered subject to policy terms).

good.name: Post-hospitalization (180 days)
good.quote: The Company shall indemnify the Post-Hospitalization Medical Expenses incurred... for up to 180 days from the date of discharge from the Hospital.
good.explanation: Covers follow-up expenses up to 180 days after discharge (good, market-standard).
